content.text: Added `winapi` (`=0.3.9`) as a regular dependency for the Windows API bindings, plus a `[target.i686-pc-windows-gnu.dependencies]` section pinning `winapi-i686-pc-windows-gnu = "=0.4.0"` — the prebuilt import library that supplies the `.a` files winapi needs when linking against the GNU (MinGW) toolchain instead of MSVC. Both are current latest versions per crates.io.
